title: Degree-zero formal functions on an affine open of the proper morphism base
statement: Let $Y$ be Noetherian, $J$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaf data, $f:X\to Y$ proper, and $F$ coherent [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U$ be affine. Put $R=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I=J(U)$, $H=f_*F$, $M=\Gamma(U,H)$, $T_n=f_*(F/(J\mathcal O_X)^{n+1}F)$ and let $E$ be evaluation on $U$. There exist linear maps $\theta_n:M/I^{n+1}M\to E(T_n)$ factoring the pushforward quotient projections, and an $R$-module isomorphism $e:\widehat M\cong E(\lim T)$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] satisfying $E(\mathrm{pr}_n)\circ e=\theta_n\circ\operatorname{eval}_{n+1}$. No natural transformation from the completion of $H$ is assumed, and no coherence assumption on $H$ is needed.

source.place: Theorem 02OC, degree zero; Lemma 088B, affine calculation

proof.text: Use the affine restriction dictionary to obtain the fixed restricted scheme Z, proper morphism g to Spec R, restricted ideal K and module P, with the ideal equality required by globalSections_formal_functions. The dictionary gives the section isomorphism a and the quotient-system isomorphism b, including the quotient projection equation.
R is Noetherian by IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian. Apply globalSections_formal_functions I g K hK P hP to obtain theta_0 and e_0, with both quotient and limit projection equations.

Transport theta_0 along reduceModIdeal of a.toLinearEquiv and along b at each level. Evaluate its factorization on a representative x; the theta_0 equation and the dictionary quotient equation prove the transported theta equation. Transport the completion by AdicCompletion.congr, the diagram limit by HasLimit.isoOfNatIso b, and the evaluated limit by preservesLimitIso. Their projection equations and evaluation of the completion congruence prove the final equation.

lean.statement: theorem formalFunctions_affine_pushforward_sections {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (F : CoherentModules X) (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : let R := Γ(Y, U) let I := J.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ let H := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj let M := Γ(H, U) let T := formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U) ∃ θ : ∀ n : ℕ, (M ⧸ (I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M))) →ₗ[R] E.obj (T.obj (op n)), (∀ n : ℕ, ModuleCat.ofHom ((θ n).comp (Submodule.mkQ (I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)))) = E.map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj))) ∧ ∃ e : ModuleCat.of R (AdicCompletion I M) ≅ E.obj (limit T), ∀ n : ℕ, e.hom ≫ E.map (limit.π T (op n)) = ModuleCat.ofHom ((θ n).comp (AdicCompletion.eval I M (n + 1)))
